titulo: Your keys could change the TV channel

frases.texto: Your keys could change the TV channel.
The TV was listening for a note you can't hear.
A little hammer hit a metal rod.
The rod rang about forty thousand times a second.
Channel up, channel down, the sound, and the power.
A jangle of keys could fool the TV.
So could a glass, when you clink it.
Now the button blinks a light your eyes can't see.
Your phone never makes that note.
The app talks to the TV over your wifi.
The app is in the link in bio.
Send it to that friend whose keys still live on the table.
